source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The dialog-position tolerance helper compares overhang placement against containerRect.right/bottom minus the dialog margin or containerRect.x/top plus the margin. It names separate candidate predicates and reports their aggregates through four assertions. These are alternatives, not a unique-position assertion. Read the comparisons themselves: horizontalContainedInTarget actually places target edges inside the dialog, and verticalCoversTarget checks only target top y. Those names/comments are not accurate whole-containment contracts. Static test-source inspection only.
title: Dialog position tests compare overhang edges in the container coordinate frame
